scope: Supplement to first assessment A, not a second independent reviewer or blinded evaluation. No technique labels changed.

reviews.solution_rationale: Largest-digit subtraction is optimal: induction gives monotone optimal cost, since the maximum digit of k-1 is at least maximumDigit(k)-1. Compress the deterministic descent into decimal suffix blocks. Store cost and negative overshoot for suffix length, incoming last digit and maximum external prefix digit. Compose ten smaller blocks; only at most nine units are lost across a decimal boundary. The independent drain implementation exercises this recurrence without iterating n times.
reviews.complexity: O(D*10^3) preprocessing with O(D*10^2) canonical block states; D<=19. Use 64-bit costs.
reviews.verification: Own block recurrence matches unrestricted digit-choice DP for every n1..10000; n=10^18 computes113502443819651915. scripts/research/verify_cses_specialist_a.py. Author archive analysis was only a heading and supplies no evidence.

reviews.solution_rationale: The actual mbfibat implementation handles n1,2 directly and all six normalized n3 letter arrangements. For n>=4, normalize the empty pair to the right, then move the first misplaced B pair out and bring a later A pair into its position. The sole adjacent-BA remainder has a three-move repair. Each ordinary iteration fixes another A in the prefix; output itself costs quadratic characters. Detailed finite cases and legal disjoint pair moves establish an implementable construction under the1000-move allowance.
reviews.complexity: O(n^2) time including scanning/output, O(n) moves and O(n^2) stored output.
reviews.verification: Compiled author code:360 seeded cases covering n1..6,20,50,100; every emitted move and final ordering independently validated; max213 moves. Returned NO only for n<=3. Random tests are not exhaustive impossibility proof.

reviews.solution_rationale: Use g(n)=mex{g(i) XOR g(n-i):1<=i<n-i}; losing iff g(n)=0. Compute through1999 and classify n>=2000 as first within the stated n<=10^6 domain. This shortcut has an explicit finite computational basis: Achim Flammenkamp reports Grundy values through2^35, with42 zero values including heap0 and largest zero at1222. The mrsac7 author implementation uses the same2000 cutoff. Do not describe eventual positivity as a proved theorem for unbounded n.
reviews.complexity: O(B^2) preprocessing with timestamped mex, B=2000; O(t) queries and O(B) memory. The cited set-based code adds a logarithmic factor.
reviews.verification: Primary computation report specifically covers the full CSES domain; source frequency table for nimber0 shows count42, last1222. No independent recomputation through10^6 claimed.

reviews.solution_rationale: For each bottom row form empty-cell heights. Assign each interval uniquely to its rightmost minimum with previous strictly smaller and next smaller-or-equal boundaries. If its left/right choices are L,R, the number of width-w intervals is min(w,L,R,L+R-w) for1<=w<L+R. Every height1..h contributes. This trapezoid has three affine pieces: rectangle-add slope/intercept on the height-width answer plane, then take two-dimensional prefix sums. The downloaded author code implements an equivalent two horizontal integrations and one vertical suffix integration.
reviews.complexity: O(nm) time and O(nm) memory, including the mandatory nm outputs.
reviews.verification: Own direct boundary/trapezoid oracle matches brute rectangles at every size on592 exhaustive binary grids (1x4,2x3,3x3). scripts/research/verify_cses_specialist_a.py.

reviews.solution_rationale: Rectangular-grid Hamilton paths have a complete endpoint feasibility characterization, beyond checkerboard parity: one-row endpoint restrictions, two-row separating endpoints, and three-row exceptional placements. The inspected implementation normalizes orientation, rejects forbidden cases, uses explicit small templates, then removes two-column strips and splices them into a boundary edge or splits into two feasible endpoint rectangles. Rotation/reflection remaps the resulting moves. This is a substantial case-based construction, not generic exponential Hamiltonian search.
reviews.complexity: Conservative bound for inspected recursive string implementation: O(nm(n+m)) time and space upper bound; output length nm-1. n,m<=50. Template lookup is constant.
reviews.verification: Compiled pinned implementation:1900 endpoint/grid cases, including all pairs for dimensions1..5 and500 seeded dimensions up to50. Independently validated786 YES paths visit each cell once and end correctly. NO answers not brute-verified; primary theorem supports characterization. Archive analysis_en.md is empty beyond heading; it is not evidence.
